stops.name: The House
stops.tag: Eun/Yu Residence · 28 Country Club Lane South · Briarcliff Manor
stops.lede: Every module, post and window on this page comes from the Res4 budget pricing set.

stops.name: Site Conditions
body: Brick, concrete and soil, 8 to 11 feet deep under the house. The report calls for removing it and replacing it with structural fill.

keys.design: Removal of the old fill and structural fill, per Carlin-Simpson.
keys.ours: Carried to 4 feet under the basement. Deeper fill is priced as found.

stops.name: Modular Scope
stops.tag: From the Signature Building Systems estimate, August 14, 2026
body: Seven modules, framed, sheathed and weathertight when they arrive. The crane, the rigging and the set crew are ours.

stops.name: Building Envelope & Exterior Finishes
body: Black-stained western red cedar over the factory's sheathing. Roofing at every mate line and parapet.

stops.name: Preliminary Schedule
stops.tag: Built with Res4, Signature and the slope contractor
stops.lede: Mobilize January 4. Set day April 27. Keys by November 5.
stops.moves: Dates depend on NYS approval, the slope repair, the building permit and the factory slot.

stops.name: Alternates
stops.lede: Priced with markups. Switch one on to see it on the house.

stops.name: Pre-Construction
body: We find solutions that hold the design intent, the quality and the excitement that started the project.
Every option is priced from our proprietary cost database before anyone commits to it.

stops.name: Thank You
stops.h2: Thank you for the opportunity to build your house.
body: We are fully committed to giving you the best experience we can.

groups.name: Site Work
groups.scope: Mobilization, excavation, erosion control, utilities and site demolition.

groups.name: Foundation and Steel
groups.scope: Foundations, slabs, dampproofing, drains, helical piles and structural steel.

groups.name: Modular Package, Signature
groups.scope: Seven modules from the factory, less the engineering the Owner already paid.

groups.name: Building Envelope and Decks
groups.scope: Framing, sheathing, insulation, cedar, stucco, roofing, windows, glass, railings and decks.

groups.name: Hardscape
groups.scope: Terrace, retaining walls and auto court.

groups.name: Plumbing, HVAC, Electrical
groups.scope: Connections between modules and all site-built MEP. HVAC is the $160,000 allowance.

groups.name: Interior Finishes
groups.scope: Stair, trim, floors, tile, paint, closets, millwork, counters and appliances.
